o: Get ready for musical fun and new friends, as we follow the daily lives of Zed, Addison, and the entire Seabrook crew. Using A-Spen’s alien time warp technology, Zed and Addison start their senior year all over again, so they can redo it with all their friends! And this senior year is going to be the best one ever, with the crew hanging out, having fun, and doing everything from saving the town…

eps.o: Zed, Addison, and the Seabrook crew get to redo their senior year together!
Zed creates a new drink called zoda that turns the entire school into zoda-obsessed zombies!
Eliza and Bucky compete to see whose vending machine is better.
Zed and Addison use their free period to help the stressed-out A-Spen learn to let loose.

eps.t: These Boots Were Made for Willa
eps.o: When Willa’s favorite boots go missing, she teams up with Lost ‘n’ Found Detective Bree to track them down.
Zed and Addison’s clones turn on them and try to steal their lives.
Wynter and A-Spen start a band! But can they reconcile their differing musical visions?
Willa and Bucky put Wyatt through an “alpha-dog-boot camp” to help him win over Eliza.
Bucky turns the school into a Bucky-themed dystopia.
When Bonzo discovers mysterious blueprints in the diner, he becomes possessed by the desire to build a spaghetti waterfall!
Addison is determined to help Dae, the quirky new witch at school, feel welcome.
Zed and little sister Zoey must team up to fight a monster hunter.
The stress of directing the school play causes Addison’s alien energy to fritz.
Wyatt teams up with Eliza to help him keep a secret from the wolf pack.
Bucky adopts a zombie dog named Barky to boost his followers online.
Wyatt teams up with a monster who promises to help him get over his fight with Eliza.
Worried that they’re drifting apart, Addison and Bree set out to rekindle their BFF connection.
Addison and Zed open a supernatural pet-sitting business.
Zed watches funny videos on ShrimpTok and ends up having to save humanity.
Dae and Bree use dark magic to prove they are their favorite band’s number-one fans.
Mothership produces a reality show starring all of A-Spen's friends.
Eliza gets involved in a feud between werewolves and Sasquatches.
Visiting an alternate universe where humans, zombies, and werewolves square off in a dance battle on the night of Halloween.

eps.t: The Return of the Living Zed
eps.o: Zed is haunted by a digital phantom of his younger self.
Addison must find a way to silence her inner critic before she gives up on art altogether.

eps.t: The Dark Side of the Moonies
eps.o: Bucky experiences what it’s like to be a werewolf.
Determined to win Seabrook’s quiz bowl, Eliza builds a W-band to help her partner Wynter focus.
Dae’s lack of self-confidence causes her to shrink!
Monster hunter Harley returns to Seabrook and tries to destroy the werewolves’ moonstone.
Zed and his friends find a mini fridge, but it is too mini for them to share.
Bree wants to get into the Cheer Hall(way) of Fame, but a negative comment destroys her confidence.
Zed gets tutored by a Debate Bot. Addison and Willa debate the importance of waving.
When a dangerous sinkhole forms in the hallway, Zed and Addison build a zipline to zip over it.
Eliza and Wyatt both want to ask the other to the school dance, but mishaps keep getting in their way.
Feeling pressured to plan her future, Wynter uses VR to find her dream job.
Addison uses advanced alien powers that she’s not ready for yet and inadvertently causes destruction at the big school dance.

eps.t: Santler Claws Is Comin' to Town
eps.o: Zed wants to throw the best zombie holiday party ever.
